A '''holovid''' was device often used to display [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] transmissions. It was larger than a [[Holopad/Legends|holopad]]. The term ''holovid'' was also used for entertainment or documentary programming displayed on a holovid, or by a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] in a [[Holotheater/Legends|holotheater]].
